issues.on_page: Grants 107,928 (Grants Fund); p2 Capital Grants and Contributions, General Government; p14 budget schedule prints 'Federal Receipts: Grants' 118,193
issues.issue: Grant with no grantor on the statement, left in other. The budget schedule groups grants under Federal Receipts (118,193 does not tie to either grant line), so federal grants is possible. Defensible, but a person should decide.

issues.on_page: Grants 128,286 (Water Fund, nonoperating; capital grants on p2/p13)
issues.issue: Business-type capital grant with no grantor printed, left in other (same question as the Grants Fund grant; the p14 budget schedule lists grants under Federal Receipts).

The Street and Recreation capital lines are labelled 'Capital Outlay: <function>' from their fund column, but the General Fund one is plain 'Capital Outlay'. Expected 'Capital Outlay: General Government' for consistency.

issues.on_page: Restricted for Community Betterment 258,927; Restricted for Grant Expenditures 78,612
issues.issue: The restricted net position lines (equity[2], equity[3]) have no category. Other reports use 'Restricted'.

issues.on_page: Totals column includes Airport Fund (Contracted Services 58, Other Operating Expenses 2,109, Depreciation 419)
issues.issue: Business-type Totals-column cost-type lines are tagged function utilities but include Airport Fund amounts. The detail lines tag those amounts function 'Airport'. Minor.
